title: Last-Letter Chain · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Last-Letter Chain · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a starting word. The lead names two new words in sequence, each beginning with the last letter of the preceding word. Both links follow the last-letter rule. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Last-Letter Chain, what counts as a successful turn?
options: Both links follow the last-letter rule.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: Both links follow the last-letter rule.
